traits.name: Devil's Sight
traits.description: Magical darkness doesn't impede the lemure's darkvision. (Descriptive only: no engine flag.)

traits.name: Hellish Rejuvenation
traits.description: A lemure that dies in the Nine Hells comes back to life with all its hit points in 1d10 days unless it is killed by a good-aligned creature with a bless spell cast on that creature or its remains are sprinkled with holy water. (Descriptive only: out of encounter, and plane- and condition-gated. Not regen. See docs/SRD_MONSTERS_DEFERRED.md.)
